title: stale header comment says wc_AesGcmSetKey is incompatible — now false
description: crypto2dev_port.h lines 50-53 say 'wc_AesGcmSetKey() is not compatible with a crypto2dev devId' and advise using wc_AesSetKey instead. This was true before commit a34b459dc, but the fix (returning CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE from crypto2dev_aes_setkey_ctx) lets the software key schedule also run, which computes aes->rounds, which makes wc_AesGcmSetKey work correctly. The warning is now a lie. Scenario A: a maintainer sees 'return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE' in setkey and 'fixes' it to 'return 0' to claim ownership, re-introducing the KEYUSAGE_E regression. Scenario B: a user reads the header and writes an unnecessary workaround, then asks why. The test_tls13_integration() comment at line 691 reinforces the stale claim and must also be updated. Maintenance consequence: the wrong API contract will cause either user confusion or a future regression.
